GOAL: Prevent stale queue reconciliation from overwriting a newer durable FAILED/CANCELLED/COMPLETED dispatch state and falsely reporting a failed BullMQ job as ENQUEUED.
SCOPE: packages/queue/jobs.ts only if retry/existing-job semantics require adjustment
new or existing focused dispatch reconciliation concurrency test
REQUIRED_BEHAVIOR: ENQUEUED/PENDING reconciliation must commit its state transition only if the durable row is still in an eligible predecessor state.
A concurrently persisted FAILED, CANCELLED, or COMPLETED state must not be overwritten by a stale dispatch attempt.
Existing failed BullMQ jobs are retried only when the durable row is FAILED and explicit retryAuthorization passes the canonical safe policy.
The caller must distinguish a stale/no-op CAS from actual successful delivery and must not report false success.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Do not widen retryable error codes beyond active authority.
Do not make FAILED retry implicit.
Do not convert CANCELLED/COMPLETED back to ENQUEUED.
Do not mutate NEXY.AI-Test-AI directly while isolated worker branch law remains blocked.
ACCEPTANCE: A deterministic interleaving test pauses reconciliation after the initial ENQUEUED read, persists FAILED, then resumes reconciliation.
Final durable state remains FAILED and lastError remains intact.
BullMQ failed job is not reported as newly delivered without authorized retry.
Equivalent tests cover CANCELLED and COMPLETED winning over stale reconciliation where applicable.
Normal PENDING/ENQUEUED delivery and explicit safe FAILED retry continue to pass.
Independent review and exact-SHA post-integration reverify complete.
UNBLOCK_CONDITION: Authoritative policy establishes a Git-valid isolated worker branch namespace or explicitly authorizes an equivalent isolation mechanism.
BLOCKER_RESOLUTION: Current explicit user authority requires isolated worker branches under NEXY.AI-Test-AI/work/; branch namespace is Git-valid and already in active use by peer tasks. This task is reactivated without direct integration-branch mutation.
